subject: Scientific Instruments Change - Funk Island Bank
text:
Scientific Instruments Change - Funk Island Bank
The Wave Glider C34167NS travels between 48 59.108N 050 06.943W and 48 33.681N 049 43.010W.
The copper-colored underwater glider measures 3.05 meters by 0.81 meters. Its mast, 1.5 meters above the water's surface, supports a fixed white light and an orange visibility flag. Remotely controlled and equipped with a non-transmitting AIS receiver, it travels at a speed of approximately 1 knot.
For more information, authorities and mariners can contact Sue L'Orsa at 250-877-8052, Tyler Byrne at 902-719-7078 or the Liquid Robotics Wave Glider Operations Center at +1 888-574-4574 or 408-636-4205.
Caution.
